comment: Station catalogue: per Station kind (the keys of catalogue.json 'stations'), its display_name and Transforms. A Transform turns 'inputs' (Item ids, placed one at a time; may be empty) into 'outputs' (Item ids; may be empty). Each kind's input sets must differ. Verbs: 'instant' completes when its inputs are in; 'tap' needs 'taps' empty-handed presses; 'hold' advances only while an Operator Holds the action key, for 'duration' s; 'walk_away' runs by itself for 'duration' s, or 'crank_duration' s while an Operator Holds it. 'transmit': true sends a transmission on completion (it consumes its inputs and has no outputs). Outputs inherit the frequency of the first input that has one; a Radio's take the Radio's.
